meta.title: MBG Puzzles – Codebreaker & Word Puzzle, free brain games in 10 languages
meta.description: Two free logic games for Android: Codebreaker (find the secret number) and Word Puzzle (find the secret word, 4–8 letters). Ten languages, no ads, works offline, daily puzzles.
meta.keywords: word game, number game, brain games, logic games, word puzzle app, code breaker game, Mastermind numbers, Bulls and Cows, Wordle alternative, daily word puzzle, word game in Albanian, word game in Bosnian, Arabic word game, free puzzle game without ads, Android

hero.h1: A word game and a number game, in ten languages
hero.lead: MBG Puzzles is a free Android app with two logic games. In Codebreaker you find a secret number, in Word Puzzle a secret word. Every guess gets coloured clues. Play in English, Albanian, Bosnian, German, Spanish, French, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese or Arabic.
hero.liveNote: Free for Android phones and tablets.

games.title: Two games, one app
games.intro: Both games use the same coloured clues, so once you know one, you know the other.

code.name: Codebreaker
code.text: The app picks a secret number of 4 to 8 digits. Digits can repeat and the number can start with 0, so a 4-digit secret is one of 10,000 numbers and an 8-digit secret one of 100 million. Type a number of the same length and every digit gets a clue.
facts: A number keypad while you guess
The classic code-breaking game, in the family of Bulls and Cows

word.name: Word Puzzle
word.text: The app picks a secret word of 4 to 8 letters in the language you play. Type a word of the same length and every letter gets a clue. The normal level uses everyday words. The Expert level ⭐ picks from the whole dictionary.
facts: Ten languages, each with its own letters
As many games as you like, not one a day

clues.title: How the clues work
clues.intro: After every try, each letter or digit gets a colour.

legend.O: Green: right letter or digit, in the right place
legend.?: Yellow: it is in the answer, but in another place
legend.X: Grey: it is not in the answer

clues.wordCaption: Word Puzzle: three tries to find {secret}
clues.wordExplain: First try: A is in the right place, L and E are in the word but in other places, R and T are not in it. The second try keeps A, N and G. The third try is right.
clues.codeExplain: First try: 1 and 3 are in the number but in other places, 2 and 4 are not in it. Second try: 3 and 1 are right, 5 and 8 belong somewhere else. The third try is right.
clues.repeat: Repeated letters and digits count one by one. If the answer has one A and you type two, only one of them gets green or yellow.

daily.title: Puzzles of the day
daily.lead: Every day there is one number of the day and one word of the day in each language. Everybody gets the same puzzle, so you can compare results with friends and family.
points: The number of the day has 4 digits. The word of the day has 5 letters (4 in Arabic).
Each puzzle can be played once. New ones arrive at midnight, your phone's time.
Share your result as coloured squares. The letters and digits stay hidden, so nobody gets spoiled.
Every solved puzzle earns 2 hint credits. Days in a row earn a bonus: +3 at 3 days, +7 at 7, +14 at 14 and +30 at 30.
daily.shareHead: 🧩 MBG Puzzles – Word of the day #12
daily.shareLine: ✅ Solved in 3 tries · 🔥 5 days in a row
daily.shareLegend: 🟩 right letter, right place · 🟨 in the word, wrong place · ⬛ not in the word

items.p: Switch at any time. Each language has its own words and letters, and Arabic runs right to left.
The free edition has no ads and no purchases. Play as many games as you like.
Everything runs on the phone: on the bus, on a plane or anywhere without signal.
After the third try, a hint opens one letter or digit. You get 10 free hint credits a day.
Games played, wins, streaks, average tries and your fastest win, for every length and language.
Large tiles, the Atkinson Hyperlegible font made for readers with low vision, adjustable text size and six backgrounds.
If you like, every digit and letter beeps like a key on an old push-button phone.
One code carries your names, scores and statistics to a new phone. No account needed.
No account, no ads, no tracking. What you type stays on your phone.

audience.title: Who it is for

items.p: Logical thinking, spelling, memory and concentration, in short games with a clear end.
A quick workout for the brain on the commute or in a break, and an alternative to chess when there are only a few minutes.
Practise the words of a language you are learning: German, Spanish, French, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese, Arabic and more.
The same puzzle of the day for everyone makes a friendly daily contest at home or at school.

audience.calm: Calm by design: no ads and no chat. A quiet, focused kind of screen time.

languages.title: Ten languages
languages.intro: Each language has its own list of everyday words for normal games and a large dictionary for the Expert level.
languages.note: In Spanish, French and Portuguese, accents are optional: árbol is played as ARBOL. Arabic tiles read from right to left.

items.a: A free Android app with two brain games: Codebreaker, a number guessing game, and Word Puzzle, a word guessing game. Both work in ten languages and give coloured clues after every guess.

items.a: It uses the same idea: guess a word and get green, yellow and grey clues. The differences are words of 4 to 8 letters, ten languages, as many games as you like, an Expert level, hints and a word of the day in every language.

items.q: Is Codebreaker like Mastermind or Bulls and Cows?
items.a: Yes, it is the same classic code-breaking idea with numbers. Here every digit gets its own clue in its own place, which makes it easier to learn. The secret has 4 to 8 digits and digits can repeat.

items.q: Is there a word game in Albanian, Bosnian, Turkish, Polish or Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Word Puzzle has its own word lists in all ten languages: English, Albanian (Shqip), Bosnian (Bosanski, Latin script), German, Spanish, French, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Arabic.
Yes, from about 9 years. There are no ads, no chat and no links to social networks, and nothing about the player leaves the phone.
No. Both games and the puzzles of the day work offline.

After the third try, a hint opens one letter or digit at a place you have not found yet. A hint costs 1 credit and counts as 2 extra tries in the score. You get 10 free credits a day (up to 50 a week), and every solved puzzle of the day earns 2 more.

items.q: What data does the app collect?
items.a: None. There is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Names, scores and settings stay on your phone. Read the [privacy policy](privacy).
items.a_world: Nothing, unless you join the optional world top 20 (from 13 years), which shows your player name, country and best scores. There is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Read the [privacy policy](privacy).

items.a: MBG – Merkur Beqiri Games, the games of independent developer Merkur Beqiri. MBG is based in Kosovo and operates worldwide: the games are made for players everywhere, in ten languages. Questions and ideas are welcome by [phone](tel), [WhatsApp](whatsapp) or [e-mail](mailto).
